description: Lightweight multi-protocol & multi-source command-line download utility (aria2-next fork, packaged as aria2c so Scoop's aria2 helper detection works).
notes: This is aria2-next, an actively maintained fork of aria2, installed under the app name 'aria2' with the executable named 'aria2c.exe'.

That naming is deliberate: Scoop only uses aria2 when it finds '<root>\apps\aria2\current\aria2c.exe', so this package makes 'scoop install parakeet/aria2' wire aria2-next into Scoop's multi-connection downloader automatically.
Both 'aria2c' and 'aria2-next' shims are provided. Run 'scoop config aria2-enabled false' to fall back to the built-in downloader.
Upgrading from the old 'aria2-next' package: run 'scoop uninstall aria2-next' first, otherwise the two packages will fight over shims\aria2c.exe.
